name: Input Subsystem
purpose: Implement multi-device input mapping, action buffering, and gamepad support.
inputs: Device matrix, gameplay action inventory, rebinding policy, and input latency ceiling
Buffering and coyote windows, chord rules, dead zones, curves, and gesture constraints
Hot-plug behavior, persistence format, accessibility presets, and replay fixtures
outputs: Action-mapped multi-device input pipeline with bounded buffering and calibration
Conflict-safe rebinding and versioned persistence implementation
Replay, calibration, device-churn, latency, and dropped-input evidence
stop_conditions: Scripted input yields identical action streams across supported simulation rates
No scripted replay drops or double-fires actions within declared bounds
Token budget exhausted or a required target device is unavailable
